description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to exempt Avic International Hotels Lanka Limited from the application of Provisions of Sec. 2 of the Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, No. 38 of 2014 in relation to an Allotment of land in R. A. De Mel Mawatha, Colombo 03
